address: 170 Sappasit Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Ubon Ratchathani, Ubon Ratchathani, 34000, Thailand
bio: The name Indochine is derived from the connection between two countries - Vietnamese family recipes have been served here for over 50 years. And family is the key to this popular business where everyone pitches in. The restaurant boasts vintage décor, using old wooden furniture and tables made from defunct sewing machines. The Vietnamese rice cake with grille pork is highly recommended, while the signature namnueng comes in a big basket with a mix of fresh local vegetables....
